rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion himself or give it to Kagan/Kavanaugh to craft a narrow, administrable rule harmonizing Guerrero-Lasprilla with Patel: review is available only for legal misapplication to agency-found facts, not factfinding or reweighing. Alito is very likely to dissent on administrability/functional grounds, and one or more textualist/pragmatic concurrences (Thomas/Gorsuch/Barrett) may emphasize strict policing against disguised factual challenges.
